purpose: Operational readiness checklist for pilot geographies — investigative only; no site lock.

checklist_fields.question: Named school district / college / Extension / hospital partner with contact?
Usable facility identified (shop, lab, clinic, classroom, land)?
Pathway runnable under existing LEARNS/CTE/Perkins/WIOA authority without new statute?
Eligibility worksheet complete for at least one real funding stack?
Registered apprenticeship or workforce board partner engaged?
Employer and/or union participation letter or MOU interest?
Documented community meeting / LCL participation — not invented?
District CTE / concurrent enrollment pipeline quantified?
Student/worker transportation plan feasible for catchment?
Local governance body for pilot measurement and accountability named?
Pre-registered outcomes + county longitudinal baseline attached?
Pre-registered expansion / stop / revise criteria written?
